evidenceNotes: All current UI screenshots show the actual game DOM and real model/audio state, not concept preview controls. The built production screenshot has no developer access.

Long-score fixtures assign the real model distance, freeze its loop, and call the actual HUD/render paths. Damage/death fixtures use the existing collision/update path. Baseline before-images retain their recorded state values and hashes.

Four approved Concept A images are copied unchanged from the reviewed 80f2923 design ZIP; 15 fresh baseline production images were captured before integration. They are explicitly labelled in comparisons.

Both production fonts and their notices exactly match approved source hashes. Only Oxanium 500 and Plex Mono 400 are shipped; no third-party runtime CDN, concept images or review controls enter the game build.

Original Game, InputManager, core, World/VFX, asset management, AudioManager/SoundPanel and pre-existing tests remain byte-equivalent to the approved baseline. The HUD alone adapts live presentation and caches unchanged values.
Native dialog focus/return, actual persisted audio controls, touch through HUD, loading progress/retry, long values and native safe-area environment overrides are checked in Chrome.
Matched rendering measurements retain the same browser/GPU/viewports/seed/hazard fixture. Cached HUD timing is separately labelled as a synchronous static-model microbenchmark.
The two missing-model tests intentionally create recoverable HTTP 404 errors; all other browser flows require clean console/network logs.
limitations: Physical phones, Safari/Firefox, sustained thermal/heap behavior, localization and screen-reader user testing remain unverified.
Emulated native safe-area insets verify CSS behavior, not physical notch/OS chrome. Static comparisons do not prove subjective player preference.
No gameplay, audio synthesis, monetization or Yandex SDK features were added. Subjective audio listening acceptance remains separate.
The existing Vite chunk-size advisory remains; no threshold change or framework dependency.
